competences.description: Becomes frenzy whenever an enemy attacks. Attacks all enemies 2 times to stun them. Greatly increases the damage and the chances to stun the enemies proportionate to the number of times the Beast becomes frenzy. The frenzy effect will reset after the attack.

Attacks the enemies in the frontline 2 times with a sharp thorn. The damage increases substantially as the target's Defense decreases. This attack will target the backline if there are no enemies left in the frontline.
Attacks all enemies 3 times with an enraged roar and summons 8 Fire Minions. The HP of the Fire Minions will increase every time the Fire Minion Summoning is used.

Removes all beneficial effects on all enemies and attacks them 6 times with fire breath to inflict damage that ignores all beneficial effects that reduce damage taken. Makes the remaining Fire Minions explode to inflict great damage.
